notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.35 adds weighted CA1, CA2, CA3 and examination marks alongside result totals and grades, using saved assessment snapshots. Authorised score editing now includes recorded CBT marks with before-and-after audits, automatic relocking and protection against later upload overwrites. Academic reviewers can open a whole-class score register across all arms, with student search, test filters and pagination. Existing scores, attempts and published results are preserved. Install on each desktop between examinations after backing up. No tablet APK update is required.
